services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: The Anderson Artists Guild is a dynamic community dedicated to celebrating and promoting the arts. This juried exhibit showcases the members’ exceptional artwork and provides first-, second-, and third-place awards as well as merit awards. Join us to celebrate the talent of the Anderson Artists Guild. Explore the fascinating intersection of photography, art, and production within this exhibit. Witness how a scientific experiment turned into a beautiful collection showcasing the seamless connection between the artist and the print process. The exhibit Art in Layers showcases the talent and creativity of the Upcountry Fiber Artists, a group of six textile artists hailing from the Carolinas.

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Kay Gallery and Gallery 2, located in the upstairs area of the Warehouse, each comfortably seat 150 guests. These two galleries, each at 2500 square feet, provide a rustic yet industrial setting that is the perfect combination of elegant and charming. With original works of art gracing the walls, the galleries provide a sophisticated and creative ambiance. The open floorplan features exposed brick walls and original hardwood floors. Just beyond the gallery doors is an open patio that easily extends the event outside.
